## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?

Consumer Discretionary soft: RCL (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +6.06%) CORRECTION, ROST (1W: -3.68% | 1M: +8.48%) CORRECTION. Industrials pockets of fatigue: HON (1W: -2.80% | 1M: +5.00%) CORRECTION, GE (1W: -3.71% | 1M: +0.08%) CORRECTION.

Top 5: MPC (1W: +19.09% | 1M: +19.12%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +14.84% | 1M: +15.47%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +33.83%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +13.18% | 1M: +17.63%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +11.30% | 1M: +28.10%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Energy) — cyclical names concentrated.

Best 1W movers: MPC (1W: +19.09%), PSX (1W: +14.84%), PLTR (1W: +14.81%), VLO (1W: +13.18%), INTU (1W: +11.30%). Watch major divergence: MSFT (1W: -0.60% | 1M: +25.59%) CORRECTION, AMZN (1W: -2.62% | 1M: +3.99%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -1.55% | 1M: +5.95%) CORRECTION — multiple large caps showing 1W vs 1M splits, so watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed internal rotation: NVDA (1W: +2.88% | 1M: +6.02%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -2.20% | 1M: -6.71%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -6.62%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +0.47%) ABOVE TREND. Tech shows leadership pockets but mega-cap divergence.

8. Financials Outlook?
Cautious constructive: JPM (1W: +1.91% | 1M: +4.67%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: -1.17% | 1M: +3.09%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -1.55% | 1M: +5.95%) CORRECTION — breadth positive but large-cap payments have short-term pullbacks.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive bid but mixed: JNJ (1W: +1.98% | 1M: +6.10%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +2.29% | 1M: +9.87%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -1.22% | 1M: -4.65%) BELOW TREND — select drug names and insurers diverge.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy and select Tech winners (MPC (1W: +19.09% | 1M: +19.12%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +14.84% | 1M: +15.47%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +11.30% | 1M: +28.10%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to large-cap growth laggards AAPL (1W: -2.20% | 1M: -6.71%) BELOW TREND and GOOGL (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -6.62%) BELOW TREND; monitor MSFT (1W: -0.60% | 1M: +25.59%) CORRECTION for confirmation.

BULLISH: MPC (1W: +19.09% | 1M: +19.12%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +14.84% | 1M: +15.47%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +0.47%) ABOVE TREND — watch follow-through. BEARISH: MNST (1W: -50.58% | 1M: -52.37%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -6.62%) BELOW TREND, AIG (1W: -4.93% | 1M: -0.98%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +7.03% | 1M: +10.12%) — strong breadth and leaders. Technology (1W: +3.95% | 1M: +8.76%) — pockets of AI/infra strength. BEARISH: Consumer Staples (1W: -2.73% | 1M: -0.52%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -0.60% | 1M: +2.62%) — watch for continued downside.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: +2.88% | 1M: +6.02%) ABOVE TREND for hold above its 1M uptrend as confirmation; AAPL (1W: -2.20% | 1M: -6.71%) BELOW TREND — failure to reclaim 1M trend risks more pressure; MPC (1W: +19.09% | 1M: +19.12%) ABOVE TREND — watch follow-through above this week’s high; MSFT (1W: -0.60% | 1M: +25.59%) CORRECTION — reclaim of 1W decline would signal resumption.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LRCX (+60): Lam Research expansion headline; LRCX (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +0.47%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. PFE (+75): higher guidance / trial news; PFE (1W: +2.29% | 1M: +9.87%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. CSCO (+55): AI/networking headlines; CSCO (1W: -6.13% | 1M: +1.52%) CORRECTION — bullish headlines but price is pulling back, divergence to monitor.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
HON (-50): disappointing guidance at investor event; HON (1W: -2.80% | 1M: +5.00%) CORRECTION — sentiment aligns with short-term weakness. (Limited cross-referenceable names in provided sentiment list; monitor other flagged names in news feed for confirmation vs price.)

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, style mixed / no clear leadership given strong breadth but concentrated Energy leadership. MPC (1W: +19.09% | 1M: +19.12%) ABOVE TREND and LRCX (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +0.47%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while AAPL (1W: -2.20% | 1M: -6.71%) BELOW TREND and GOOGL (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -6.62%) BELOW TREND show large-cap weakness. Key risk: major divergence among large caps (MSFT, AMZN, MA) and select bearish news (HON) — watch for trend confirmation before enlarging positions.
